question:
Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?

1. BRISK: DTKUM

2. CLOUD: ENQWF

3. FLAME: HNCOG

4. GRANT: HVCRV

5. HOUSE: JQWUG
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] The logic applied here is based on the shift in alphabetical position of each letter in the words. Option (1) 'FLAME - HNCOG': [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bef7cac97a3b77fed427a5a0bdbd60430b949d1598c389fe70f5332ee99e276.png]
